title: [review] schc_adaptation.json: ACK bitmap inconsistent with assigned_fc
description: For frag_ack_bitmap_single_missing, assigned_fcns lists [62, 61, 63] (2 regular tiles + All-1), but the bitmap 0x28 shows bits at positions 0 and 2 set (FCN 62 and FCN 60 received). If only FCNs 62, 61, 63 were sent, position 2 should not be set. Either assigned_fcns is incomplete or the wire format is incorrect.
